description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian fast-food pizza chain founded in 1967, with over 750 locations coast to coast. This New Westminster outlet offers both indoor and outdoor seating along with takeout service. The chain carries a broad menu including vegetarian options and gluten-free crust, making it a quick calorie-refuel stop for riders passing through downtown New Westminster.
